pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: big 2-story body, ridge N-S near x 572; N end hipped (dark V, about 7/12, 541 sq ft), S end a gable: the 10/12 W and E faces (1209 and 1303 sq ft) run the full length to the S eave with no S-facing face

pieces.name: south_wing
pieces.notes: narrower cross hip inside the S gable end, ridge N-S near x 548 from about y 560, hipped at the S eave; LiDAR shows small W, E and near-flat S pieces here, so a hip is the best single primitive

pieces.name: north_bay
pieces.notes: small hip entry bay at the N eave with its own dark N face about 6.5/12 (185 sq ft)

pieces.name: west_bay
pieces.notes: small 1-story bump-out on the W wall, single W-facing plane about 5/12 (80 sq ft), low confidence

exclude_notes: house shadow band north of the eave, trace overshoots
notes: 2-story body with a hipped N end and gable S end (v1 had it as a full hip, which put a big S face where LiDAR has none), cross hip at the S, small N bay, W bump as a shed. Confidence high on main, medium on the S wing.
